##Three-Space High Pincer
This wide pincer is a bit unusual, but if you have a position at the lower right, such as weak white stones or a black enclosure, it can be good. ([AlphaGo vs. Alphago with Michael Redmond 9p: Game 9](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G0XJhPvQ9sc&t=2m38s).)

[Explanation by Go Inside on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/mNRXteU13HA?si=XQQ2HIjQd7aYCxtQ)
